science_protocol.candidate_universe: all5183 corpus abstracts; never inject gold papers
science_protocol.selector: production exact-string split and frozen semantic policy
science_protocol.confidence_intervals: seeded percentile bootstrap,2000 repeats; claim units for SciFact; related claims can remain dependent
science_protocol.no_positive_policy: 112 no-positive claims included as closed-benchmark INSUFFICIENT; evidence F1 denominator excludes these and reports their selections separately

splits.SciFact: dev already inspected; locked descriptive evaluation, not untouched final test
splits.CSFCube: official fold1_dev24 and fold1_test26 tasks, seven query-paper IDs overlap; no tuning here
splits.RECIPER: entire1024-question release; frozen zero-shot source-paper ranking, not a held-out split

selection_policy: Freeze settings and report every case. No threshold/model selection from these results.
protocol_caveat: Offline corpus benchmark replaces web discovery; functional live-provider checks are separate. Top100 branches/top5 papers define an automated evaluation wrapper, not a claim that the UI automatically selects papers.
documentation_finding: Pinned BM25 is a custom NumPy implementation, not a call to rank-bm25; correct dependency descriptions separately.
source_hash_policy: Raw SHA retained; LF-normalized SHA permits CRLF-only checkout differences. All other byte changes fail.
